FN-3O85VV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 321
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative James Lomax
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/27/2023
House Bill 321 as introduced could increase the potential obligations of any governmental body,
county, or municipality that purchases an unmanned aircraft system by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the difference in 1) the cost of the unmanned aircraft system purchased by such
government entity; and 2) the cost of the unmanned aircraft system that otherwise would have
purchased but is prohibited by this bill.
Page 1

FN-3O85VV-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 321
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative James Lomax
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/03/2023
House Bill 321 as reported by the Committee on State Government could increase the potential
obligations of any governmental body, county, or municipality that purchases an unmanned
aircraft system, with exceptions, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in:
1) the cost of the unmanned aircraft system purchased by such government entity; and 2) the
cost of the unmanned aircraft system that otherwise would have purchased but is prohibited by
this bill.
